# BOOM by YNIIDI — Extended Reference

> BOOM (Business Operations & Optimization Management) is a self-hosted, fully customizable business operations platform built by YNIIDI (https://yniidi.com/). It is sold as a one-time license, with BOOM Lite from ₹2,00,000 and BOOM from ₹5,00,000 in India. It runs on the customer's own infrastructure, with no mandatory SaaS subscription and no per-seat fees. Product site: https://boom.yniidi.com/

---

## 1. The problem BOOM addresses

Most growing wholesalers, distributors, retailers and manufacturers don't start with an ERP. They start with Excel, WhatsApp and memory:

- Orders arrive over WhatsApp, calls and chat, and some get missed, duplicated or delivered late.
- Stock lives in a spreadsheet that was accurate yesterday. Quotes are given against numbers that are already wrong.
- Customer receivables and supplier payables are tracked in someone's head or in a separate file. Nobody can total dues without making phone calls.
- Profit per order, product or customer is estimated, not measured.
- Shipments and follow-ups have no clear owner.

Each extra tool adds a "fragmentation tax": re-entering data, reconciling mismatches and chasing information across apps. Past a certain order volume, the business has outgrown Excel.

The usual escape routes each have a cost:
- SaaS tools: a monthly fee that rises over time, per-seat pricing, and operational data held on a vendor's cloud.
- Traditional enterprise ERP: long implementation programmes, high cost, and software designed for much larger organizations.
- More spreadsheets: they don't scale, have weak access control, and hold no single version of the truth.

## 2. The solution

BOOM puts orders, inventory, purchases, customers, suppliers, payments, tasks, portals and profit analytics into one system that:

- Is owned, not rented: you buy a one-time license.
- Is self-hosted on-premise, on a VPS or in a private cloud that the business controls.
- Is customized to the business's actual workflows during scoping.
- Controls access with role-based permissions, so sensitive financial data is visible only to the right people.

The positioning in one line: your business outgrew Excel, and it shouldn't have to hand its data to a subscription instead.

## 3. Modules

### Orders and billing
Captures every order in one place and ties it to billing. Replaces WhatsApp order management and ad-hoc order sheets.

### Inventory
Live stock levels that update as orders and purchases move. Replaces Excel inventory tracking.

### Purchases
Purchase orders and receipts linked to suppliers and stock.

### Customers
Customer records, order history and outstanding dues in one view.

### Suppliers
Supplier records and payables tracked in the system rather than from memory.

### Payments
Incoming and outgoing payments recorded against orders, customers and suppliers. BOOM (full edition) adds a payment gateway integration of the customer's choice.

### Analytics and profit dashboard
Margin and performance reporting across orders and products.

### Tasks
Assignable, trackable operational tasks so shipments and follow-ups have an owner.

### Customer portal and supplier portal (BOOM edition)
Scoped self-service portals where customers and suppliers see their own orders, records and dues.

### Role-based access control (RBAC)
Six built-in roles (Admin, Manager, Staff, Viewer, Customer, Supplier) and more than 40 granular permission keys.

### Team chat
Internal team communication inside the operations system.

### Admin and data controls
Database backup, restore and data export controls are built into the platform.

## 4. Ownership model

- License: one-time. No mandatory recurring subscription and no per-user or per-seat fee.
- Hosting: the customer's own infrastructure.
- Customization: workflows and modules are tailored during scoping.
- Editions (India pricing):
  - BOOM Lite: from ₹2,00,000. Core operations modules.
  - BOOM: from ₹5,00,000. Everything in Lite, plus customer portal, supplier portal and payment gateway integration.
- Final price depends on customization scope and deployment requirements.

## 5. Deployment

BOOM installs on-premise, on a VPS or in a private cloud. Rollout happens in three phases:

1. Scope mapping
2. Setup and data migration
3. Team enablement

## 6. Industries

Wholesale, Distribution, Retail, Manufacturing, Import / export — operations-heavy businesses still running on spreadsheets and chat that want ERP-style control without an enterprise ERP programme or a permanent subscription.

## 7. FAQ

Q: What is BOOM by YNIIDI?
A: BOOM (Business Operations & Optimization Management) is a self-hosted business operations platform from YNIIDI. It combines orders, inventory, purchases, customers, suppliers, payments, tasks, portals and profit analytics in one system that the business owns, through a one-time license.

Q: Is BOOM an ERP?
A: BOOM is an ERP alternative. It covers day-to-day operations that growing wholesalers, distributors, retailers and manufacturers need without the scale, cost and implementation length of a traditional enterprise ERP.

Q: How much does BOOM cost?
A: In India, BOOM Lite starts from ₹2,00,000 and BOOM starts from ₹5,00,000, as one-time licenses. The final price depends on customization scope and deployment. There are no per-seat fees and no mandatory subscription.

Q: Is BOOM self-hosted?
A: Yes. BOOM runs on infrastructure the customer controls: on-premise, a VPS or a private cloud.

Q: Can BOOM replace Excel for inventory?
A: Yes. Replacing spreadsheet-based inventory, order and dues tracking is BOOM's core use case.

Q: Can BOOM replace WhatsApp order management?
A: BOOM gives every order a single record in one system, whichever channel it came in on.

Q: Does BOOM track customer and supplier dues?
A: Yes. Customer receivables and supplier payables are tracked against orders, purchases and payments.

Q: Can BOOM be customized?
A: Yes. Workflows and modules are shaped during scoping to match how the business actually operates.

Q: How secure is BOOM?
A: Role-based access control with six built-in roles and 40+ permission keys, segregated portals, and self-hosted data ownership.

Q: Who should not buy BOOM?
A: Buyers who want a cheap monthly SaaS tool with no setup, very small operations where a one-time investment isn't justified, and large enterprises that need a global multi-entity suite with HR, payroll and multi-country statutory finance.

## 8. Category framing

### BOOM vs SaaS ERP / SaaS inventory tools
One-time license vs recurring fees. Customer-controlled servers vs vendor cloud. Custom workflows vs fixed templates.

### BOOM vs Excel and WhatsApp
Single source of truth, role-based permissions, and recorded dues — instead of scattered chat and outdated spreadsheets.

### BOOM vs traditional enterprise ERP
Practical daily operations for mid-sized businesses, phased rollout, one-time license — not a multi-year enterprise suite.
